units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:5:5">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite> bot. (expl. <he>חציים</he>) <he>חצי כל ס׳ וס׳</he> a fraction of each ingredient.—Pl. <he>סַמְמָנִים</he>, <he>סַמְמָנִין</he>, <cite ref="O00714"><he>סַמָּנִ׳</he></cite>. Ib. 41ᵈ; <cite ref="Keritot 6a:49">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>סַמְמָנֶיהָ</he>, v. <cite ref="H01410"><he>חָסַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 6a:72">Ib.</cite> <he>אחד מסַמְמָנֵי הקטרת</he> one of the ingredients of the frankincense; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 12:2:2">Y. Sabb. XII, 13ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ליטע סִימְמָנִין</he> to plant the spices for the frankincense.

senses.gloss: pl. as above: paint, dye, colors; in gen. artist’s material.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:9">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>צייר … שמצא ס׳ וכ׳</he> your god is a great artist, but he found good material which helped him.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35">Ex. R. s. 35</cite>, a. e. <he>אתה בסַמְמָנֶיךָ וכ׳</he> thou (paint it) with thy materials, but I appear in my glory myself; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 369:8">Yalk. Ex. 369</cite> <he>בסַמָּנֶיךָ</he>; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 5ᵃ <he>בסימנך</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 101a:4">B. Kam. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>שבח ס׳</he> the value of the dye (additional to that of the wool); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 13</cite> <he>סממנין</he>, v. <cite ref="O01105"><he>סִמְלוֹן</he></cite>.]
